name: Ayukawa Yuuna
source:
Kana's twin sister.
She is shy, loves to read, is petite, and has a slender build.
She is quiet and reserved.
Her personality is the complete opposite of her twin sister, Kana.
She tends to see things in a negative light.
Deep down, she is stubborn.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120113205711if_/http://www.luchs.jp/psychs/reigaku/chara04.html]official site[/url]]
